title: Hyrox - Full Sim (Pro Weights)
note: Full 8-station sim with a doubles partner, on a treadmill. Eight runs of 800 m each, so 6.4 km of running (a race run is 1 km). Garmin under-read the treadmill distance (7.48 km total with stations), so run paces are calculated as lap time over 800 m; lap times 4:35, 4:08, 4:11, 3:23, 4:02, 4:14, 4:03, 4:57. Reported by Amar: most runs at 12 km/h with the last 200 m at 13 km/h; run 8 started at 10 km/h after the sandbag lunges. Run 4 (3:23 for 800 m, 4:13/km) is faster than the reported speeds, so that lap was probably cut short. Run time 33:33, stations 26:39, transitions about 8:10. Peak heart rate 186.
